summary: Fang Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, announcing changes to its board of directors. Ms. Qifang Liu was appointed as an independent director and audit committee member, effective May 7, 2026. The board now consists of six directors, four of whom are independent. No forced or abrupt departures were disclosed; this is a routine governance update. The filing includes no deal terms, no financial consideration, and no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is a standard board appointment announcement with no material corporate action.
